title: decision: operator Ed25519 signing is deterministic; nonce intentionally absent
description: In post/sign.rs, sign_article uses ed25519-dalek deterministic signing (RFC 8032): same key + same bytes = same signature = same CID in IPFS. The comment explicitly documents that a nonce or timestamp must NOT be added because it would break CID idempotency and produce duplicate articles in IPFS. Design is correct and the rationale is documented.
